review.selectedRoute: Restrict the existing original upper-to-raised equivalence to Gamma1 using the already proved Gamma1 preservation of level raising. Reuse both existing inverse identities and the original analytic matrix/action equation. The existing Gamma1 conjugation homomorphism supplies multiplication. No new matrix arithmetic or coprimality premise is needed.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: The actual upper correspondence subgroup inside Gamma1(M), defined by upper-right divisibility, is isomorphic to Gamma1(M) intersect Gamma0(d*M). The forward map is exactly the original diagonal conjugation, and the inverse is the existing integral level-raising matrix. Both inverse laws and the analytic matrix/action identity are proved at every positive index.
review.remaining: This group isomorphism does not itself identify the Picard and H1 operators. Their transpose/diamond conventions and the original homogeneous matrix coefficient action still require exact comparison. The full/parabolic H1 distinction, Frobenius/inertia, finite-character Galois realization, original all-weight characteristic-zero association, local/image/regularity, arithmetic automorphy and literal higher symmetric-power continuation remain required. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
